column1: # Expected effective rights of v7-must-match (chapter 2.5 acceptance README, «Варианты манифестов»):
# role, action, key, allow | deny. Format: `role<TAB>action<TAB>key<TAB>expect`.
# Requester vb creates va/items rows (worker.creates); common row validation (row-check contract) reads:
# - targets of the destination's ref/must_match fields — va/shelves/* (forward branch);
# - catalogue rows whose field has a ref to the destination table and must_match — vc/links/* (REVERSE must_match branch).
